data.one_liner: A Flutter UI kit and Material 3 theme with a warm amber-on-near-black sci-fi aesthetic.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop-in Material 3 ThemeData and a standalone library of custom HUD widgets featuring a chamfered sci-fi aesthetic. It includes bundled fonts, light and dark variants, and runtime customization options for accent, bevel, and glow.
use_when: You want a sci-fi, HUD, or cyberpunk aesthetic for your Flutter app.
You need a drop-in Material 3 theme with custom HUD widgets like stat cards, segmented meters, and terminals.
avoid_when: Your app requires a standard Material or Cupertino look without sci-fi styling.
You need built-in state management, routing, or data layer utilities.
strengths: Includes bundled fonts with platform fallbacks and zero manual font setup required.
Customizable via accent, bevelScale, and glowScale parameters.
weaknesses: Niche aesthetic style that is unsuitable for standard business or consumer apps.
Contains no state management or data layer capabilities.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and apply AurisTheme.dark() or AurisTheme.light() to your MaterialApp theme.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a standard Material design styling instead of a specialized sci-fi HUD theme.
